title: Plan to move the program to Kwajalein / South Pacific

tellings.quote: And you know, ideally they said they would have loved to go out to the South Pacific maybe Kwajalein Island or something but they said the expenses would have been so great it's just impossible.

plain: Bob Lazar, who says he worked in the late 1980s at S4, a secret site in the Nevada desert where he says alien craft were studied, says the people running the programme told him they would have liked to move it to the South Pacific, maybe to Kwajalein Island. According to Lazar, they said the cost would have been so great that it was impossible, a detail that, if true, shows how seriously they guarded the work.
